verbs.name: edit.add_shape
verbs.description: Place a vector SHAPE overlay: rect | ellipse | line | arrow — plus an optional centered label on a box shape (a styled callout box). Rendered by the same in-house resvg keyframe engine as titles (so it gets overlay placement + fade animation + content-addressing) and composited on a top-most title overlay track over [range_ms[0], range_ms[1]). Lowers to honest import + insert ops (the generated .mov lives in the project's titles/ dir). GEOMETRY (all normalized [0,1] against the project geometry): rect/ellipse use the BOX x,y,w,h; line/arrow use x,y as the START point and x2,y2 as the END point. PAINT: fill (#RRGGBB, omit for outline-only on box shapes) + opacity; stroke (#RRGGBB border / line color) + stroke_px; radius_px (rect corners); head_px (arrowhead length). A box shape with neither fill nor stroke defaults to a white outline so it's never invisible. text (+ color, font_px) draws a centered label inside a rect/ellipse. animation overrides the default fade (fade|slide_up|slide_down|slide_left|slide_right|pop|none).

shape.description: The shape kind. rect/ellipse use the box (x,y,w,h); line/arrow use the endpoints (x,y → x2,y2).

range_ms.description: [start_ms, end_ms) on the timeline (absolute); the shape animates over this span

x.description: Box left (rect/ellipse) OR start point x (line/arrow), normalized [0,1]

y.description: Box top (rect/ellipse) OR start point y (line/arrow), normalized [0,1]

stroke.description: Stroke/border color #RRGGBB (rect/ellipse) or the line color (line/arrow)

stroke_px.description: Stroke/line width in px (default 4 for box shapes, 8 for line/arrow)

head_px.description: Arrowhead length in px (arrow; default ~4× the line width)

text.description: Optional centered label inside a rect/ellipse (a styled text box)

font_px.description: Label font size in px (default ~5% of project height)

animation.description: Entry/exit animation override (default is a tasteful fade)

group_id.description: Internal composite-action identity. Consecutive generated/native-lowering edits with the same value undo as one user action.

verbs.result: {shape_track, asset_id, clip_id, shape, range_ms}; lowers to import + insert ops
